task.title: Expose OpenClaw operations in BFF
task.summary_zh: 補 BFF OpenClaw operator surface：upstream status、session lifecycle、tool/workflow audit、paper/live gate state、degraded reason 都能看見。
acceptance: BFF reads OpenClaw status and sessions through service client
BFF exposes tool workflow audit and degraded reason
BFF displays paper and live gate state without enabling them
operator commands require auth and idempotency
tests cover healthy degraded and denied states
